mapper.select: select (select count(1) from sp_equipment_asset where del_flag = '0') as totalAssets, (select count(1) from sp_equipment_category where del_flag = '0') as totalCategories, (select count(1) from sp_equipment_borrow where del_flag = '0') as totalBorrowRecords, (select count(1) from sp_equipment_borrow where del_flag = '0' and status = '0') as pendingBorrowApprovals, (select count(1) from sp_equipment_borrow where del_flag = '0' and status = '5') as overdueBorrows, (select count(1) from sp_equipment_repair where del_flag = '0' and status in ('1', '2')) as repairingAssets

select a.asset_id as assetId, a.asset_name as assetName, c.category_name as categoryName, ifnull(sum(b.quantity), 0) as useCount, round(if(a.stock_qty = 0, 0, (ifnull(sum(b.quantity), 0) / (a.stock_qty * 12)) * 100), 2) as usageRate from sp_equipment_asset a left join sp_equipment_category c on a.category_id = c.category_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join sp_equipment_borrow b on a.asset_id = b.asset_id and b.del_flag = '0' and b.status in ('1', '3', '4', '5') where a.del_flag = '0' group by a.asset_id, a.asset_name, c.category_name, a.stock_qty order by useCount desc, a.asset_id asc limit 10

select d.dict_label as reasonLabel, r.fault_reason as reasonValue, count(1) as total from sp_equipment_repair r left join sys_dict_data d on d.dict_type = 'sp_repair_reason' and d.dict_value = r.fault_reason where r.del_flag = '0' group by r.fault_reason, d.dict_label order by total desc

select m.mon as month, ifnull(t.total, 0) as borrowCount from ( select date_format(date_sub(curdate(), interval 11 month), '%Y-%m') as mon union all select date_format(date_sub(curdate(), interval 10 month), '%Y-%m') union all select date_format(date_sub(curdate(), interval 9 month), '%Y-%m') union all select date_format(date_sub(curdate(), interval 8 month), '%Y-%m') union all select date_format(date_sub(curdate(), interval 7 month), '%Y-%m') union all select date_format(date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 month), '%Y-%m') union all select date_format(date_sub(curdate(), interval 5 month), '%Y-%m') union all select date_format(date_sub(curdate(), interval 4 month), '%Y-%m') union all select date_format(date_sub(curdate(), interval 3 month), '%Y-%m') union all select date_format(date_sub(curdate(), interval 2 month), '%Y-%m') union all select date_format(date_sub(curdate(), interval 1 month), '%Y-%m') union all select date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m') ) m left join ( select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') as mon, count(1) as total from sp_equipment_borrow where del_flag = '0' group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') ) t on m.mon = t.mon order by m.mon asc

select #{statMonth} as statMonth, a.asset_id as assetId, a.asset_name as assetName, c.category_name as categoryName, a.stock_qty as stockQty, a.available_qty as availableQty, ifnull(b.monthBorrowCount, 0) as monthBorrowCount, ifnull(r.monthRepairCount, 0) as monthRepairCount, ifnull(rt.totalRepairCount, 0) as totalRepairCount, if(a.purchase_date is null, 0, timestampdiff(year, a.purchase_date, #{referenceDate})) as usedYears, round( if( a.purchase_date is null, 0, greatest(0, timestampdiff(month, a.purchase_date, #{referenceDate}) / 12 * ifnull(a.depreciation_rate, 0)) ), 2 ) as accumulatedDepRate, case when a.asset_status = '3' then '建议报废' when a.service_life_year is not null and a.purchase_date is not null and timestampdiff(year, a.purchase_date, #{referenceDate}) >= a.service_life_year then '建议报废' when ifnull(rt.totalRepairCount, 0) >= 5 and ifnull(r.monthRepairCount, 0) > 0 then '建议报废' when a.available_qty <= greatest(1, floor(a.stock_qty * 0.2)) and ifnull(b.monthBorrowCount, 0) >= greatest(6, floor(a.stock_qty * 0.6)) then '建议采购' else '持续观察' end as suggestion, case when a.asset_status = '3' then '资产状态已报废' when a.service_life_year is not null and a.purchase_date is not null and timestampdiff(year, a.purchase_date, #{referenceDate}) >= a.service_life_year then '超过设定使用年限' when ifnull(rt.totalRepairCount, 0) >= 5 and ifnull(r.monthRepairCount, 0) > 0 then '累计报修频繁且当月仍有故障' when a.available_qty <= greatest(1, floor(a.stock_qty * 0.2)) and ifnull(b.monthBorrowCount, 0) >= greatest(6, floor(a.stock_qty * 0.6)) then '低库存高需求' else '指标稳定，继续观察' end as suggestionReason from sp_equipment_asset a left join sp_equipment_category c on a.category_id = c.category_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join ( select asset_id, sum(quantity) as monthBorrowCount from sp_equipment_borrow where del_flag = '0' and status in ('1', '3', '4', '5') and create_time >= #{startTime} and create_time < #{endTime} group by asset_id ) b on a.asset_id = b.asset_id left join ( select asset_id, count(1) as monthRepairCount from sp_equipment_repair where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= #{startTime} and create_time < #{endTime} group by asset_id ) r on a.asset_id = r.asset_id left join ( select asset_id, count(1) as totalRepairCount from sp_equipment_repair where del_flag = '0' group by asset_id ) rt on a.asset_id = rt.asset_id where a.del_flag = '0'
and ( a.asset_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or a.asset_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.category_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and ( case when a.asset_status = '3' then '建议报废' when a.service_life_year is not null and a.purchase_date is not null and timestampdiff(year, a.purchase_date, #{referenceDate}) >= a.service_life_year then '建议报废' when ifnull(rt.totalRepairCount, 0) >= 5 and ifnull(r.monthRepairCount, 0) > 0 then '建议报废' when a.available_qty <= greatest(1, floor(a.stock_qty * 0.2)) and ifnull(b.monthBorrowCount, 0) >= greatest(6, floor(a.stock_qty * 0.6)) then '建议采购' else '持续观察' end ) = #{suggestionType}
order by field( case when a.asset_status = '3' then '建议报废' when a.service_life_year is not null and a.purchase_date is not null and timestampdiff(year, a.purchase_date, #{referenceDate}) >= a.service_life_year then '建议报废' when ifnull(rt.totalRepairCount, 0) >= 5 and ifnull(r.monthRepairCount, 0) > 0 then '建议报废' when a.available_qty <= greatest(1, floor(a.stock_qty * 0.2)) and ifnull(b.monthBorrowCount, 0) >= greatest(6, floor(a.stock_qty * 0.6)) then '建议采购' else '持续观察' end, '建议报废', '建议采购', '持续观察' ), ifnull(b.monthBorrowCount, 0) desc, a.asset_id asc
